name: Tamarindos Freaking Dinner
description:
Mascot Horror in a 90´s escape room! deliver your pizza order to Tagomago´s Mansion, but be careful, dinner is not the pizza..its YOU! escape from this haunted house and his 7 cannibalish inhabitants in a time loop with more than 25 endings!

The sequel to BAOBABS MAUSOLEUM and the second game on Jacob Jazz´s TREELOGY!
